captures.alt: Knowledge Library shows 1656 repository records, 3278 links and the selected KnowledgeStoreProvider canonical record.
captures.caption: Browse the repository-derived record graph and resolve canonical detail.
captures.evidence: Actual installed Knowledge Library example plugin (npm run build --prefix examples/knowledge-library, installed through the Plugins page) on an isolated Station built from 171fcbe0c: own home, instance rem-capture-kl, ports 43621/43631. Fresh export of this revision's atlas, module map and review ledger (input digest 1024718b7c30) imported through the public SDK (createKnowledgeRoot, then the example ingest --apply) into a new project root; the first apply stopped after 1656 confirmed creates before its final readback and the identical rerun created nothing and verified 1656 canonical records/3278 links. No graph/detail API fixture. Actual deep selection of KnowledgeStoreProvider; measured at 1440×1000 with no horizontal overflow (document width 1440). Only user.name changed to Sample User, by rewriting that field in the browser's /api/auth/status response. Host was heavily loaded, so the plugin registry needed Retry extensions before the pane loaded; keyboard return and a next selection were not re-run for this capture. No provider, embedding/index or native proof. Repository content is an explicitly derived snapshot at 171fcbe0c; matching source hashes are not semantic approval.
